name: Dumorelin

lead: Dumorelin is a peptide that activates the growth hormone-releasing hormone receptor, like sermorelin, tesamorelin and CJC-1295.
People interested in leaner, more muscular physiques follow this class because growth hormone signalling is tied to lean mass and fat metabolism.

paras: It binds the GHRH receptor on the pituitary, prompting growth hormone release, which raises IGF-1.
Little individual data is published. Growth hormone secretagogues as a class can raise IGF-1, prolactin and cortisol. Dumorelin is sold for research use only and is not an approved medicine.

chain: Raises IGF-1 signalling linked to lean mass and recovery
angle.text: As a GHRH-receptor agonist, dumorelin is grouped with peptides people use in pursuit of leaner, more muscular physiques. Specific data on dumorelin itself is sparse.

lead: Dumorelin is a peptide that acts as an agonist at the growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) receptor, placing it in the same family as sermorelin, tesamorelin and CJC-1295 [1]. Compounds in this class prompt the pituitary to release growth hormone, which is why they appear in discussion of lean mass, recovery and body composition.

Dumorelin is listed in reference tables of growth hormone secretagogues, but it has no dedicated article there and little individual published literature [1]. Its role in appearance-related use is by association with the GHRH-analog class: growth hormone signalling is linked to lean tissue and fat metabolism, and people interested in physique use related peptides for that reason.
infobox: Not an approved medicine in major markets

paras: GHRH analogs bind the GHRH receptor on pituitary cells and stimulate growth hormone release. The class has been used clinically for growth hormone deficiency, and many secretagogues also raise IGF-1, and in some cases prolactin and cortisol [1].

Sermorelin has been studied in children with idiopathic growth hormone deficiency, tesamorelin (Egrifta) in HIV-associated lipodystrophy, and CJC-1295 as a long-acting analog tested in healthy adults for sustained GH and IGF-1 secretion [1].
Dumorelin is sold by chemical suppliers labelled for research use only, a category also used for other peptides discussed in physique communities.
No studies found. Studies of related GHRH analogs such as sermorelin, tesamorelin and CJC-1295 exist and are summarised on the growth hormone secretagogue page [1].
